topics.title: Pattern Matching, Immutability & Pipe Operator
topics.objective: Deconstruct tuples, maps, and lists declaratively using the match operator and composable pipes.
topics.exercise: Write a pipeline that reads, filters, and transforms a CSV dataset into structured maps using Enum and Stream.

topics.title: BEAM Actor Model, Processes & Message Passing
topics.objective: Spawn lightweight isolated actor processes and exchange asynchronous messages with mailboxes.
topics.example: pid = spawn(fn -> receive do {:ping, sender} -> send(sender, :pong) end end)
topics.exercise: Implement a ping-pong process pair communicating via send and receive blocks with timeouts.

topics.title: GenServer Behaviors for State Abstraction
topics.objective: Standardize stateful servers with init, handle_call, handle_cast, and handle_info callbacks.
topics.example: def handle_call({:get, key}, _from, state), do: {:reply, Map.get(state, key), state}
topics.exercise: Build an in-memory key-value cache GenServer with TTL expiration support.

topics.title: Supervisors & 'Let It Crash' Fault Tolerance
topics.objective: Design self-healing actor supervision trees using one_for_one and rest_for_one strategies.
topics.exercise: Construct a supervision tree that restarts a failed database connection worker without interrupting web requests.

topics.title: DynamicSupervisor & Distributed Registry
topics.objective: Scale dynamically spawned user session processes registered via unique pub/sub keys.
topics.exercise: Create a multi-room chat session manager dynamically spawning and routing messages to room workers.
